result.document_summary: Massachusetts General Laws c. 186, § 11, which sets a 14-day written notice to quit as sufficient to end a written lease for nonpayment of rent, with a right to cure and a hearing continuance where government payment delays caused the nonpayment.
result.notes: The section governs only termination of a written lease for nonpayment of rent (notice period, cure right, continuance for government payment delays). It does not set rent caps, deposit limits, screening fees or restrictions, algorithmic pricing rules, or a just-cause eviction regime (a list of permitted causes, relocation assistance, or general coverage), so no in-scope rule was extracted. A reviewer could treat it as a narrow just-cause-type procedural provision, but it does not define permitted eviction causes beyond nonpayment.
